Here Allah (4c) tells us of His kindness to His slaves, so that they
may know Him, love Him, and seek His kindness and generosity.
Another shade of meaning of the word lateef (translated here as
^kind^) indicates that He knows what is in their hearts and minds,
which leads His slaves - especially the believers - to that which is
good for them in a manner that they do not know or anticipate.
One aspect of His kindness to His believing slave is that He guides
him to that which is good in ways that never cross his mind, by means
of what He makes available to him of causes that lead him to that,
such as creating in him the love of truth and submission to it, and His
inspiring His noble angels to help the believers to be steadfast, and
urge them to do good, and make truth fair-seeming in their hearts in
order to motivate them to follow it.
Another aspect of His kindness is that He enjoins the believers
to do communal acts of worship which strengthen their resolve and
motivate them, and lead them to compete in doing good and seeking
